item.title: Trajan Decius, 249-251 AD. AR, Antoninianus. 5.00 g. 21.37 mm. Rome.
item.description: Trajan Decius, 249-251 AD. AR, Antoninianus. 5.00 g. 21.37 mm. Rome. Obv: IMP C M Q TRAIANVS DECIVS AVG. Bust of Trajan Decius, radiate, draped, cuirassed, right. Rev: DACIA.
